projection.units: dimensionless uncalibrated DAMIT coordinates; physical scale from the documented calibration

surfaces.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 97.7 km (catalog ±1.56 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery. The physical size is approximately calibrated by assigning the AKARI thermal effective diameter to the mesh volume-equivalent diameter. Neither source mesh nor spin is modified. Convex inversion supplies only broad outline; no resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture can be inferred. The 2016 archive supplies one convex solution (54,-10). The 2021 ASAS-SN (54,-15) estimate agrees at broad-pole level; retain selected nominal coordinates/spin and an explicit AKARI size approximation.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
